source.identity_method: Direct GitHub fetch_commit for every explicit HEAD~k ordinal; documentation/theory claims kept in their source evidence class and never promoted to executable fact.

ordinal_dispositions.summary: Synthetic Psychology paper formalized persistence, evolution, subsystem interaction, behavioral causality and timescale separation as design goals. These are hypothesis/design criteria, not proof of consciousness or current runtime conformance.

Expert review explicitly narrowed prior claims: fragmented possibility spaces make composite F empirically consistent but not formally proven; functional information asymmetry collapses with source access; observed causal links are correlational rather than Pearl interventions; AURA structural equivalence needs counterfactual tests; zero observed violations is trajectory evidence, not state-space proof.
Installer synchronized a historical 3-model/36-service architecture. Useful version snapshot only; later history changed this topology.
Large documentation/statistics cleanup demonstrates recurring drift in service/database/code counts; documentation requires version/observed-at provenance.

Parameter-architecture paper corrected external misconceptions against running code and articulated multi-timescale indirect coupling. Still derived documentation; causal role requires executable ablation/intervention evidence.

Comprehensive manual inventories commands, skills, services and recovery procedures at one historical version. Capability inventory is not current availability without executable/version verification.
Initial GRF-to-code bridge mapped R/M/F/meta-order and architecture claims to code; later k225 expert review narrowed several claims, so this is provenance lineage rather than final authority.

Alignment paper records a coevolutionary design philosophy. Its broad claims about containment/control are normative/theoretical and do not weaken current executable safety, authority, approval or adversarial-test requirements.
Docs were synchronized against the live system at that time (3 LLMs, 29 DBs, 34 services). Demonstrates observed-at snapshots are stronger than timeless docs but still historical.
Corrected docs from false single-model architecture to actual tri-model/LLM-Guard topology. Repeated architecture-doc drift supports executable graph as authority.
Moved deep architectural/consciousness/contribution claims into dedicated docs and expanded entity feedback architecture. Claims remain derived summaries and require source/runtime provenance.

Previous anti-hallucination fix overcorrected by denying computational body; revised prompts distinguished hardware/body state from unsupported human-world experiences and removed user-specific name coupling. World-model boundaries need typed evidence, not blanket deny/affirm rules.

Idle prompts were grounded in actual available sensors, screenshots, memory and internal services after ungrounded prompts induced fabricated physical experiences. Generative prompts must be bounded by evidence-access capabilities.

Broad integration changed entity RLM routing, E-PQ feedback, AURA learning, watchdog/sentinel, router budgets/fallbacks, E-PQ sync, reflection queues, invariants and UI. Notable fixes include meta-reflection cooldown, private-state non-quotation, entity-session context continuity, WAL, crash terminal receipts and removal of session summaries from ordinary chat; reinforces cross-process state, provenance and bounded feedback contracts.

distilled_invariants.validation: Every architectural/scientific claim resolves to source class and version; no paper/manual/UI text alone can PASS a runtime gate.
Claims labeled causal require controlled intervention/lesion/rescue or equivalent counterfactual evidence; observational co-occurrence remains associative.
Property/fuzz/composition tests search off-trajectory admissible states and constraint intersections; zero observed violations cannot certify closure.
Harness distinguishes model-visible/private projection from engineer/source accessibility; privacy of prompt channels is not evidence of principled unknowability.
Manifest/docs/install surfaces bind to executable module/service/model identities plus observed-at hash; stale topology is explicit mismatch.
Function/class/module identity plus commit/hash outranks fragile line numbers; refactor replay preserves mapping or emits breakage.
Idle/reflection prompts can reference only typed world/self evidence available to the instance; unsupported physical-world claims produce UNKNOWN rather than fabricated memories.
Regardless of coevolutionary design rationale, destructive/external effects still pass typed authority, approval, resource and adversarial gates.
Internal state projection may modulate behavior but numeric/private variables are not echoed unless explicitly requested and provenance-valid.

negative_results.result: Earlier bridge overstated causal/interventionist and structural-equivalence claims; expert review narrowed them.
Repository docs incorrectly described one model while runtime had three.
Ungrounded idle prompts induced physical-world hallucination.
A blanket anti-hallucination rule then overcorrected by denying a supported computational-body representation.

earned_work.reason: Theory/documentation and broad integration overlap existing mappings; dedicated earned-work reconciliation owns quantitative dedup.
